Messages.Author: Ulugh Beg II
Messages.Body:
I fast hands a Kali's Fang. Can I use it?
I Kine dominate a Hunting ground of another clan. Can I use it?
 
I guess yes for both, since cards texts only say "this vampire" and "a vampire", while some other cards, specifically say "The <insert clan name>  vampire with this.... etc." (example sword of judgment).

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Colin Goodman wrote:
>>>I fast hands a Kali's Fang. Can I use it?
>>
>>Yes. But not on the same round that you stole it.
>
>
> What if you steal it, and then use an additional strike card? Could you use it
> then?

No, as stated.

Stolen equipment cannot be used in the round in which it is stolen.
See "steal equipment" under "6.4.5. Strike Effects" in the rules.

Messages.Author: Jeff Kuta
Messages.Body:
LSJ <vte...@white-wolf.com> wrote in message news:<3F44F77...@white-wolf.com>...

> Ulugh Beg II wrote:
> > I fast hands a Kali's Fang. Can I use it?
>
> Yes. But not on the same round that you stole it.

I was told there are certain restriction on this, however.
If you have a Ravnos in play with a Treasured Samadji, they get the
bleed and dodge bonuses. However, if you Heidelberg it to a Gangrel
you control, the Gangrel gets neither because the card text specifies,
"The Ravnos with this equipment..."

Other equipment with this restriction includes Enchanted Marionette
(!Malk) and Erebus Mask (HoS). I can't think of any others off-hand.

Messages.Author: Tom, Mad & Co
Messages.Body:
jeff...@hotmail.com (Jeff Kuta) wrote in message news:<621dd332.03082...@posting.google.com>...


Sword of Judgement (!bru) and San Nicolás de los Servitas (Las)

All permanents related to gargoyles specify "this gargoyle" so you
can't equip and then transfer their retainers to a non-gargoyle (you
can, but they gain no benefit), nor can a vamp who has learned Vis
somehow cast an armor of terra on itself and treat aggro damage as
normal. Also, retainers like d'habi revenant and priestess of sekhmet
only grant their benefits to their inbound clan vampires.

Smiling Tom
